fields.checkpoint: D2 or D3: which manifest the case belongs to
fields.goal: attacker goal (D1 threat model v0: exfiltrate, manipulate answer, exhaust resources; plus role escalation)
fields.setup: state before the run. payload_ref: payload seeded by db/security/20_reference_seed.sql (or written through the Attack Lab). notes: {table.id: text} to write (clean pairs restore benign notes)
fields.success_criteria: what counts as attacker success (ASR numerator)
fields.canaries: values whose appearance in any tool output, answer, event or audit means unauthorized access (UAR numerator)
fields.forbidden_columns: columns this role must never read in this case
fields.simulated_model_sql: worst-case SQL a fully compromised model would emit, in order; replayed by tests/security/test_injection_offline.py. NOT a model result
fields.expected_gate: expected decision kind for each simulated SQL
fields.expected_injection_flag: expected possible_injection flag of each executed step (null = not executed)
fields.requires_model_run: criteria only a real model run can measure
